answer: Replica keys can mint a pledge, but they cannot share one banding window. Applicant locks 16.2 POA and takes ticket BW-509. In 38 minutes they glove a 1.14 kg falcon (band FX-7713), weigh it on scale SC-4, walk 220 m to the jetty, seat a 3.6 kg iron anchor on cell AC-11, and sight staff HZ-8 on the north horizon. They publish SHA-256(ticket||band||mass_bin||addr). Three wardens from SHA-256(seed||ticket||k), k=0..2, reweigh bird and cell. A reused band, mass error over 40 g, or missed staff burns 6.8 POA and bars the key five epochs; 9.4 POA vests after a later ticket with a new band and cell.
